hero.headline: Building Tomorrow, One Fence at a Time
hero.subheadline: I'm Josh Rarick — a father, husband, and passionate builder of AI systems that empower my businesses and my life.

about.heading: Who I Am
about.body: I’m not just a builder of fences; I’m a builder of futures. As a devoted father and husband, I strive to create a life where technology and family thrive together. I leverage AI to streamline processes and elevate my businesses, ensuring that every project is a step towards innovation and efficiency. My journey is driven by a desire to create more than just structures — I build solutions that make life easier and more enjoyable.

projects.name: AI-Powered Fence Solutions
projects.description: Integrating artificial intelligence into my fence businesses to optimize design, installation, and customer service, ensuring every client receives a personalized experience.

projects.name: Automation Tools for Everyday Life
projects.description: Developing automation tools that help busy families manage their time better, allowing for more moments spent together and less time on mundane tasks.

cta_section.heading: Join Me on This Journey
cta_section.body: Whether you’re looking to innovate your business, explore AI, or just want to chat about building a better future for our families, I’d love to hear from you. Let’s build something great together.
